To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) we present a system of experiment representation and integration that supports collaborative scientific research; (b) we present a general transformation-based model to represent experiment processes, a hierarchical data classification scheme, and a metadata-centric representation to concisely capture the context of experiments, as well as a metadata-centric virtual integration approach; and (c) we present a prototype system that demonstrates the feasibility of our approach.
SciPort is a system for managing and integrating experiments in scientific research.

1) we developed SciPort, a system of collaborative scientific research that integrates metadata-based representation and management of scientific research experiments, 2) we implemented SciPort as a system that can manage and share scientific research experiments, and 3) we demonstrated that our system can manage and share experiments in a scientific research community.
